title: "Manuscript Reporting"

::: {.callout-note title="Teaching outline"}
This chapter introduces the workflow. Apply it with the reviewed variable map and study protocol; the analysis templates are components, not a validated turnkey pipeline.
:::


# Methods checklist

Describe:

- data source
- study design
- diagnosis years
- inclusion/exclusion criteria
- exposure
- outcome
- covariates
- missing-data strategy
- statistical methods
- sensitivity analyses

Avoid wording that implies population-based incidence unless appropriate for the data source.
